title: Primary Qwen3-8B-Base research-behavior QLoRA experiment
research_question: Does research-behavior specialization improve Qwen3-8B-Base on unseen research tasks while preserving useful general capabilities?
hypothesis: The tuned 8B model will have higher macro-averaged structured validity and research-action accuracy than the untouched base on the frozen research benchmark.

secondary_hypotheses.statement: The tuned model will improve citation precision/recall and lower unsupported-claim rate relative to the untouched base.
The tuned model will improve insufficient-evidence recognition on cases where the supplied sources do not establish the requested conclusion.
Evidence attribution, source selection, and methodology-critique families will show larger gains than generic planning families.
Specialization may regress at least one non-target capability unless the training mixture or a general-capability control is sufficient; this is a directional risk hypothesis, not an expected result.

hypothesis_source.note: All five frozen hypotheses are preserved verbatim; H1 is primary, H2-H5 are secondary/descriptive as specified in the frozen protocol.

preregistration.primary_success_criterion: H1 is supported only if both structured_valid and action_accuracy have positive tuned-minus-base paired mean deltas and their two-sided 95% paired percentile-bootstrap intervals exclude zero.
preregistration.interpretive_guardrail: A structured-validity or formatting gain without improvement in actual research decisions will not be described as broad research-competence improvement.

bootstrap.undefined_metric_policy: pair only rows with the metric defined in both conditions

preregistration.multiple_comparisons: H1 is the single primary hypothesis; H2-H5, all task families, domains, and error categories are secondary/descriptive. No post-hoc composite score.

git.status_note: Pre-registration captures the current HEAD with a dirty working tree containing E014 preparation changes and pre-existing untracked generated data. No result-bearing run was launched and no commit was created.

machine.hardware_probe_note: MPS is available; no NVIDIA GPU/CUDA device is present. Unified memory is not dedicated VRAM.

intended_hardware.gpu: 1 x NVIDIA A100 80 GB or H100 80 GB, BF16-capable; conservative planning target, not a measured minimum
intended_hardware.cuda_runtime: CUDA 13.x runtime supplied by locked PyTorch/BitsAndBytes wheels
intended_hardware.python: 3.13 (locally tested locked dependency set; Python >=3.11 supported by project)
intended_hardware.flash_attention: not required by this recipe; SDPA/default Transformers attention is used

dataset.license_note: The frozen candidate has separate attribution-required and noncommercial source classes; retain the per-row provenance and license boundary in any later artifact or release.

control_benchmark.scoring_note: Keyword-based small regression guard; not a general-intelligence measure.

model.name: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base
model.revision_source: read-only Hugging Face git ref lookup performed before preregistration
model.prompting_protocol: Both base and tuned research evaluations use research_model.research_protocol.build_prompt with the same system instruction, task type, question, and supplied evidence; no chat template or tuned-only prompt.

checkpoint_policy.resume_policy: resume the latest valid Trainer checkpoint; append interruption/failure events

stopping_criteria.early_stop: no performance-based early stopping; stop on completion or integrity/non-finite-loss/runtime failure

material_pre_run_adjustments: Raised max_seq_length from 2048 to 4608 after exact tokenizer audit: at 2048, 1,983/19,626 training examples were truncated, 810 retained zero target tokens, and target-token retention was 87.9139%; at 4608 all train/validation/test targets are retained.

Changed checkpoint/evaluation cadence from the earlier 1,000-step/3-checkpoint policy to 500 steps and at most 5 checkpoints, with best validation eval_loss selected, to retain early/middle/final candidates without excessive checkpointing.
Set adamw_torch_fused explicitly for reproducibility; existing configuration did not specify the optimizer.
TRL 1.13.0 SFTConfig does not accept warmup_ratio; runner passes warmup_steps=ceil(2,454*0.05)=123, preserving the configured 5% warmup.

limitations: No primary baseline or training run has completed; E010 was interrupted and E011-E013 used an MLX-converted model, not Qwen3-8B-Base.
The frozen benchmark contains 248 controlled cases across 31 task families (8 per family); domain estimates are small and descriptive.
Training data are domain-skewed: training split includes only 13 behavioral-science and 13 education examples, 273 software-systems examples, and 9,984 biomedical examples.
Insufficient-evidence metric has only 8 eligible benchmark cases.
The 12-case general control is a lightweight keyword regression guard.
The dataset retains attribution-required and noncommercial source terms; no public release or relicensing is authorized.
The estimated GPU runtime is not measured and may vary substantially with hardware, driver, storage, kernel, and throughput.
conclusion: No primary conclusion is available. E014 is preregistered and READY_FOR_COMPUTE; launch only on suitable already-accessible NVIDIA hardware or after separate authorization for external paid compute.
